title: Ilocano
blurb: Learn Ilocano (Iloko) from zero: its sounds and doubled consonants, the ti/ni/iti markers, the -ak and -ko pronoun sets, verb focus and aspect, the particles that make it sound native, and what changes if you already know Tagalog.
interviewIntro: Situations to answer out loud, with model answers. Read the prompt, say your answer aloud (really aloud: speaking is a different skill from reading), then reveal the model answer and compare.
